column1: # §10 ambiguities pinned by this lane (D-002: design questions return to the orchestrator)

column2: F-D1 'the settlement window' is undefined in the spec and no exchange settlement time is pinned anywhere in the repo. PINNED: the last 1800s before the committed m0 RTH close (RTH_HI_SEC = 21:00 UTC, common.py:104). If the orchestrator means the true COMEX/CME settlement periods, they must be pinned as constants.

F-D3's BOJ leg is not buildable: calendar_boj.csv carries 2026+ only (SOURCES_FOR_PORT.md:32) and BOJ decisions have no fixed release minute (day-grain flag). F-D3 ran on FOMC + the fixed 08:30/10:00 ET slots; the BOJ sub-window is DEFERRED with a revisit hook (D-015), not dropped.

F-D2 'London-NY handoff minute' is ambiguous: the frozen phase table already opens NY at the London/NY profile boundary, so the handoff as a MICRO-open (beyond the 3 phases) is pinned to the US cash open 09:30 ET. If the intent was the phase boundary itself, that window is already G1-FAST-OPEN.

F-D4 has no stated episode-size or trigger-latency bound. PINNED: causal detectors (trailing-150s $1000 repricing; >=10s insane run) and the first confirmation strictly after the episode, same session, no latency cap (the latency distribution is reported).

§10B names 'selected 2-way cells' without a selection rule. PINNED: ALL 2-way axis pairs, with the pre-registered n>=500 FIT filter doing the selecting; every tested cell enters the Holm ledger, so the accounting stays honest.
§10B names no significance test. PINNED: one-sided Welch z on the conditional (positive-certificate) values, slice vs complement, normal tail; n>=500 makes the normal approximation safe.
